description: Validated fuel-switch fixture using biomass baseline and LPG-like project fuel. fNRB applies to baseline biomass CO2 only, not project fossil fuel. Year-1 annual ER only.

methodology_notes.headline_metric: net_er_tco2e is year-1 annual tCO2e, not lifetime
methodology_notes.fuel_basis: baseline and project fuel consumption are per household/device
methodology_notes.fnrb_application: fNRB applied to baseline biomass CO2 term only; not applied to project fuel
methodology_notes.leakage: leakage_factor set to 0 for baseline validation fixture
methodology_notes.adoption_usage: adoption_rate and usage_rate both set to 1.0
